description: Tell Threesmith that a review finding is a false alarm you verified (verdict wrong): it is hidden from later reviews on this machine, and a rule that is often wrong here gets a note. verdict right undoes that and counts the rule as useful. Stores only hashes and counters, never code, names or paths ($THREESMITH_HOME; THREESMITH_LEARN=0 turns learning off).

file.description: file of the finding (relative to path)

path.description: Project folder, or a file or folder in it (relative to the server's folder; default: the project).

rule.description: rule id; default: the finding on that line

name: three_feedback
title: Mark a review finding as wrong or right
